data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2021 (2020 GBP 12.0m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an aggregate prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.7m (net of reinsurance) in 2021. Management attributes the net release primarily to favourable claims development in Property classes, partially offset by adverse development in the Legal Indemnities class. No quantified gross prior-year movement was provided, so the reported figure is net of reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: a reserve release of GBP 5.7m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2021 (2020 GBP 12.0m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided. The report explicitly states a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.7m (net of reinsurance) and a breakdown attributing the release to Property with offset from Legal Indemnities; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as the stated NET figure (permitted fallback). A gross claims development triangle is present but a 2020 RITC transfer and formatting ambiguity in the triangle make a reliable gross PYD calculation uncertain; hence gross PYD was not calculated. Triangle present and used for cross-checking but not for primary PYD due to RITC and formatting ambiguity.
